Strengths:

  • Not elite, but very good arm. Able to deliver the ball all over the field and has plenty of zip on the ball, even when getting hit.

  • Good running ability. Despite this he is not a run first guy. Looks to throw first and usually does a good job of keeping his eyes down field when on the move.

  • Moves through his progressions quickly and makes good reads. Good field vision, most of his interceptions are on forced passes rather than poor reads.

  • Shows good accuracy and decent touch at all levels, particularly intermediate throws, when his mechanics hold up.

  • Stands in the pocket and will deliver passes with pressure in his face, doesn't take off at the first sign of trouble.

Weaknesses:

  • Mechanically inconsistent (mostly footwork) which can cause accuracy problems, especially when under pressure.

  • Predetermines throws, locking onto his target and forcing passes that lead to turnovers.

  • Relies too heavily on arm strength, often throwing without stepping into his passes.

Overall: Prescott is an intriguing prospect. Unlike a lot of running quarterbacks he looks to throw first and does a good job going through progressions. He certainly needs work on his mechanics and has to stop locking onto receivers, as it stands he shows a lot of traits you are looking for in a quarterback. Right now I would say he is an early second round guy you take and sit a year for development. He could certainly rise if he shows the growth this year that he did last year.
